svg.text: EKS cluster · Karpenter v1.12+ (no managed node groups)
During the shift: cordoned · EndpointSlices removed
Recovery after expiry is serial: every stage waits for its own polling loop (not to scale)
a missed pass waits a full cycle
recovery = sum of every polling interval
Budget recovery as additive, not parallel
the worst case is not the slowest step; it is the sum of every loop, plus any loop that waits a full cycle
≥30-min shifts or autoshift practice runs · alert on EndpointSlices
Shift expires in ARC: no notification to EKS
EKS discovers the expiry by polling ARC
Control plane removes taints, uncordons nodes
